claimBoundary.purpose: A product candidate responding to diagnostic failure patterns retained in v2, not to an eligible creator win.

budgetRevision.reason: Exact-HEAD review required the current documented metadata.hermes.config shape and quote-aware YAML comment correctness.

package.aggregateAlgorithm: SHA-256 of lines '<file-sha256>  <relative-path>\n' with entries sorted by bytewise UTF-8 relative path ascending

proves: the frozen product package and exact creator budgets reproduce
the validator runs from outside the package without Python bytecode writes
bare working-directory-relative script examples fail under warnings-as-errors
the supported Codex sidecar sections parse while required interface fields remain enforced
valid Markdown links with optional titles pass
skill names containing reserved provider strings fail
string-valued frontmatter rejects obvious unquoted collections and scalars while quoted lookalikes remain strings
trailing YAML comments do not hide non-string values while quoted hashes and block scalars remain content
the documented metadata.hermes.config shape passes while unsupported nesting and non-string leaves fail
Markdown links inside code are ignored while a real broken link is detected
common container-local paths in Markdown prose are detected
root-relative and remote web links are not misclassified as workstation paths
default reference and eval baggage and unconditional Git inspection are absent
the retained meeting-followups and weekly-status-deck path and baggage patterns are detected
